title: WEB3TV
tagline: Web3TV is a decentralised video sharing platform for content creators where each early supporter of the creator is awarded with a dynamic NFT which is associated with the growth of their channel.
description:
The challenge that every content creator currently faces on web2 or any web3 platforms is identifying their early supporters who encouraged them to produce more content and trusted their channel could produce greater value in the ecosystem

The second issue we're attempting to address is the fact that creators on web2 video platforms frequently experience issues with censorship, privacy, and other factors. Particularly web3 content producers, the channels were banned or the video would be deplatformed without prior notice or explanation. Therefore creators should have access to a platform where they can control their content and directly connect with their early supporters

Solution :
We have developed a decentralised video uploading , streaming and recording application with the help of livepeer where content creators can monetize their content by providing a membership . This membership will provide a dyanamic NFT for the early supporters which will dyanamically change at various milestones of the youtuber. To ensure one membership equals to one person we are integrating world coin to secure our platform from any bots or sybil attacks.
